# South China Morning Post

> > Leading Hong Kong-based news organization covering Asia, China, and international affairs with comprehensive journalism and digital services.

The South China Morning Post (SCMP) is a premier English-language newspaper headquartered in Hong Kong, offering print, digital, and ePaper subscriptions alongside business events and seminars focused on regional trade, ASEAN connectivity, and cross-border commerce.

- regional partnerships
- trade digitalisation
- SCMP Live events
- business seminars

## Subscription Services

- [Subscription Orders](https://customerservice.scmp.com/subscribe): SCMP subscription options for print, ePaper & corporate in Hong Kong

- [Standard Chartered SME Banking Seminar Singapore](https://scsgsme.scmp.com/): Standard Chartered SME banking seminar on SEA-China trade at Shangri-La
